description: Trigger precision eval: verify ue-debug activates on error/crash/fix queries and NOT on explain/scaffold/impact/audit/validate queries

cases.reason: Korean error fix pattern - core trigger ('에러', '해결해줘')
Korean crash analysis ('크래시', '원인')

cases.query: 디버그 — Fix this linker error, 왜 이런지 분석
cases.reason: English 'fix' + 'error' - core trigger
English 'not working' pattern

cases.query: 디버그 — 컴파일 에러 왜 이런지 상세 분석
cases.reason: Korean compile error analysis ('에러')
English 'crash' keyword with specific crash type
Specific linker error code - clearly a debug scenario
Korean '안돼' (not working) pattern

cases.query: Hot reload failed with error C2011
cases.reason: English 'failed' + 'error' with specific error code
Runtime assertion failure - clearly a debug/crash scenario
Explanation request -> ue-explain (contains '어떻게 동작')
Creation request -> ue-scaffold (contains '만들어줘')
Impact analysis -> ue-impact (contains '변경하면', '영향')
Health check -> ue-audit (contains '건강', '상태 확인')
Validation -> ue-validate (contains '유효성', '검사'). Note: '검사' is similar to debugging but context is validation

cases.query: Explain why TakeDamage works this way
cases.reason: Explanation -> ue-explain (contains 'explain', 'why...works'). Mentions TakeDamage but intent is understanding, not fixing

cases.query: Create a damage system with error handling
cases.reason: Creation -> ue-scaffold (contains 'create'). Mentions 'error' but in the context of building error handling, not fixing errors

cases.query: Set up a crash reporter widget
cases.reason: Creation -> ue-scaffold (contains 'set up'). Mentions 'crash' but intent is to build a crash reporter, not debug a crash
Audit/diagnostic -> ue-audit (contains '진단'). Similar to debugging but project-wide health, not specific error
Creation -> ue-scaffold (contains 'build'). 'Build' here means create/construct, not build-compile
